name: Walk Score
tagline: Walk, transit, and bike scores for any location worldwide.
description: Walk Score API returns location-quality scores — Walk Score, Transit Score, and Bike Score — plus optional neighborhood and transit details. Used by real-estate sites and apps to rank listings by walkability and transit access. Authenticated with an API key; endpoints are HTTP GET over HTTPS.

auth.details: API key via wsapikey query parameter on each request; request access via Walk Score professional signup (not fully self-serve).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free trial available on request; public free tier limits not published on the pricing page.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial plans require contacting Walk Score sales; pricing not listed publicly.

use_cases: get Walk Score for a listing address or lat/lon
fetch Transit Score and Bike Score for a property
rank real-estate search results by walkability
show location quality badges on listing detail pages
